title: Theth with four friends from Berlin
author: Ardit Kola
excerpt: Example post: how a day trip report from a group tour looks on the journal. Replace it with your own story and photos from the admin.
body:
This is an example post that shows how a group tour report looks on the website. Replace the text and add real photos from the admin.

We left Shkodër at 07:30 with coffee in hand. Four friends, one car, and a forecast that promised sun over the Alps.

The road up

We stopped at the Thore pass for the first view of the valley. Nobody wanted to get back in the car.

Grunas waterfall

An easy walk through the beech forest, a cold swim for the brave ones, and a long lunch at a family guesthouse.

“The best day of our whole trip.” (Lena, from the group)

Want a day like this? See the Theth tour or ask for your dates.

title: 7 days in Albania: a realistic itinerary
author: Ardit Kola
excerpt: Most itineraries try to fit the whole country into a week. This one leaves time for long lunches and slow mornings.
featuredAlt: Mountain road towards Theth in the morning
body:
Most itineraries try to fit the whole country into a week. This one doesn’t. It leaves time for long lunches and slow mornings, which is how Albania is best seen.

Day 1–2: Tirana and Berat

Land in Tirana, walk the centre in the evening, and drive to Berat the next morning.

Day 3–4: The Alps

Theth needs two nights. The road is long, and the valley deserves more than a quick photo.

Book the guesthouse before you book the car.

Day 5–7: The coast

  • Gjirokastër on the way south
  • Butrint early in the morning
  • A last swim in Ksamil

seo.title: 7 Days in Albania: A Realistic Itinerary from a Local Guide
seo.desc: A 7-day Albania itinerary that leaves time to breathe: Tirana, Berat, the Theth valley and the southern coast, with tips from a local guide.

title: Is Theth worth it? A local’s guide
author: Ardit Kola
excerpt: Short answer: yes, if you give it at least one night. Here is how to get there and when to go.
body:
Short answer: yes, if you give it at least one night.

Getting there

The road from Shkodër is paved now, but it is still a mountain road.

When to go

June to September. In October the guesthouses start to close.
